JUST IN: Nasawi ang isang lalaking nagbibisikleta matapos makabanggaan ang dump truck sa C5 Road Extension sa Quezon City.

Isinugod sa ospital ang lalaki pero idineklarang dead on arrival.

Sa imbestigasyon, nagbibisikleta ang lalaki sa eastbound lane ng Commonwealth Avenue habang paliko noon sa C5 Road Extension ang dump truck nang mangyari ang aksidente. 

Nasa kustodiya na ng QCPD Traffic Sector 5 ang truck driver habang nagpapatuloy ang imbestigasyon. | via James Agustin/GMA Integrated News

#TrafficAlert 🚦 | #TrafficAdvisory
 
In view of the *nomination processions for the 61–Jubilee Hills Assembly Bye-Elections* on **17.10.2025 (10 AM–4 PM)**, **moderate traffic congestion** is expected around **Yousufguda, Kotla Vijaya Bhaskar Reddy (KVBR) Indoor Stadium, and Krishna Nagar** due to processions/rallies by contesting candidates.
 
🚫 *Avoid these routes if possible* 🚗 *Use alternate roads for a smoother commute*
 
**Traffic Diversions (17.10.2025 | 10 AM–4 PM):**
 
1.  Traffic from **Maitrivanam Junction → Yousufguda Basti/Rahamathnagar/Karmikanagar/Borabanda Bus Stop** will be diverted at **Yousufguda Basti → Krishnakanth Park → GTS Temple → Kalyan Nagar → Mothinagar → Borabanda Bus Stop**.
 
2.  Traffic from **Maitrivanam Junction → Jubilee Hills Checkpost** via **Yousufguda Checkpost/Madhapur** will be diverted at **Yousufguda Basti → RBI Quarters → Krishna Nagar Junction → Jubilee Hills Checkpost**.
 
3.  Traffic from **Jubilee Hills Checkpost/Venkatagiri → KVBR Stadium** will be diverted at **Krishna Nagar Junction → Srinagar Colony → Panjagutta**.
 
4 Traffic from **Borabanda Bus Stop → Karmikanagar/Rahamathnagar/Yousufguda Checkpost** will be diverted at **Prime Garden Function Hall, Sri Ram Nagar X Roads → Midland Bakery → GTS Colony → Kalyan Nagar Junction → Vengalrao Nagar → Umesh Chandra Statue U-Turn → ICICI U-Turn → Maitrivanam Junction**.
 
5. Traffic from **Panjagutta → Krishna Nagar via Srinagar Colony** will be diverted at **Srinagar Colony Park → MJ College Road → SNT Junction → NFCL**.
 
📍**Parking Locations (for general public):**

1.Metro Parking (Anakamma Thota     1 & 2), Yousufguda
 
2. Savera Function Hall & Mahamood Function Hall – *4-wheelers only*

Citizens are requested to note the above **traffic advisory** and **cooperate with #Hyderabad Traffic Police** for smooth regulation.
 
#TrafficUpdate #Hyderabad #ByeElections #HYDTP #JubleeHills
